run_data_replace_scan: run the script to scan a directory for unsafe .replace('data:', ...) usage
check_file_ast: check a python file for .replace('data:', ...) calls using AST parsing
check_file_regex: check any file for .replace('data:', ...) calls using regex matching
scan_directory_issues: scan a directory recursively for .replace('data:', ...) in python and code files
review_visitor_class: review the DataReplaceVisitor AST visitor class that detects .replace('data:', ...) calls
